license.question: How do I book without a boat license?
license.answer: Part of our fleet consists of “pleasure craft license” boats that are accessible without a license (up to 6 horsepower and a limited length under current regulations). Filter listings with the “No license required” criterion to find them easily.

cancellation.question: What are the cancellation terms?
cancellation.answer: Free cancellation is available up to 7 days before departure. Between 7 and 3 days, 50% of the amount is refunded. Within 3 days, no refund applies, except in cases of force majeure.

delivery.question: Do you deliver to the marina?
delivery.answer: Depending on the listing, the boat can be delivered directly to your pontoon or preferred departure point. This option is shown on the boat page and may involve an extra fee depending on distance.

res-comment-reserver.q: How do I book a boat on SailingLoc?
res-comment-reserver.a: Sign up, then search for a boat (port, dates, number of people) in France, Europe, or internationally. Choose a listing and click "Book": you are guided through to secure payment. A confirmed booking constitutes a rental contract between you and the owner.

res-contrat.a: SailingLoc is a peer-to-peer rental platform for registered individuals only. Every confirmed booking establishes a rental contract between the renter and the owner. SailingLoc acts as an intermediary and does not replace the obligations of either party.

res-annuler.a: Yes, you can cancel from your "My bookings" area. Refund terms depend on the cancellation policy chosen by the owner (flexible, moderate, or strict) and how far in advance you cancel before departure.

res-refus.q: What happens if the owner declines my request?
res-refus.a: If your request is declined, no amount is charged and the request is closed. You receive a notification and can immediately search for another boat. SailingLoc does not charge anything when a request is declined.

res-delai.q: How far in advance should I book?
res-delai.a: SailingLoc does not impose a minimum lead time, but each owner can set a minimum notice period (for example 24 or 48 hours). This period is shown on the listing. We recommend booking at least one week ahead in peak season.

res-modifier-dates.q: Can I change the dates after confirmation?
res-modifier-dates.a: Changing dates after confirmation requires the owner's agreement. Contact them via the built-in messaging. If you reach an agreement, the booking will be cancelled and recreated with the new dates, subject to the applicable cancellation policy.

pai-modes.a: SailingLoc accepts major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) via Stripe, our secure payment partner. Bank transfers and cash are not accepted on the platform.

pai-debit.a: The full amount is charged online via Stripe as soon as you confirm your booking. The booking automatically moves to "Confirmed" status after a successful payment.

pai-caution.q: How does the security deposit work?
pai-caution.a: The owner can set a security deposit amount in their listing. This amount is shown for information only: the actual handling (card hold or deposit) is arranged directly between renter and owner before departure.

pai-remboursement.q: Can I get a refund if I cancel?
pai-remboursement.a: Yes, subject to the owner's cancellation policy. With a flexible policy, you are fully refunded up to 24 hours before departure. With a strict policy, only 50% may be refunded. SailingLoc service fees are non-refundable.

pai-frais.a: SailingLoc takes 10% of each confirmed transaction. The exact service fee amount is always clearly shown before you confirm a booking.

pro-mettre-en-location.q: How do I list my boat for rent?
pro-mettre-en-location.a: Create an individual account, select the "Owner" role, then add your boat (type, capacity, equipment, rate, photos). After verification, your listing goes live: you rent only to other registered individuals, under a rental contract created with each booking.

pro-documents.q: What documents are required to publish a listing?
pro-documents.a: You must provide the boat's registration documents, your ID, and a valid navigation insurance certificate. These documents are reviewed by our team before your listing goes online.

pro-commissions.a: SailingLoc takes 10% of each confirmed transaction. The breakdown is shown before booking confirmation and in your owner dashboard (earnings).

pro-paiements.q: How and when do I receive my payments?
pro-paiements.a: The renter pays online via Stripe when booking. Payouts to the owner are tracked in the "Earnings" area. Automatic transfers via Stripe Connect are planned for phase 2.

pro-bloquer-dates.q: Can I block dates on my calendar?
pro-bloquer-dates.a: Yes. From your owner dashboard, open "Availability" for each boat. You can block periods for personal use, maintenance, or any other reason. Those dates will not appear as available to renters.

sec-assurance.a: Each owner must provide valid navigation insurance covering rental to third parties. SailingLoc checks these documents before listings go live and works with insurance partners. Also review coverage terms with the owner before departure.

sec-dommages.q: What happens if there is damage during the rental?
sec-dommages.a: If damage occurs, report it immediately via messaging and fill out the incident form available in your booking. SailingLoc mediates between renter and owner. Any security deposit is handled directly between the parties based on the findings.

sec-verification-locataires.a: Only registered users can book. During sign-up, renters must provide a valid ID. A review system lets owners see feedback left by other members. Unverified profiles are flagged to owners.

sec-permis.a: It depends on the boat type and sailing area. For boats over 6 HP at sea or on regulated lakes, a recreational boating license is required. The owner indicates in their listing whether a license is needed.

sec-verification-proprietaires.a: Yes. Before any listing is published, owners go through identity and document verification (ID, proof of ownership or boat management contract, insurance). This process helps ensure the reliability of published listings.

1.title: Article 1 - Purpose
1.body: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of the SailingLoc platform, available at sailingloc.fr and published by SailingLoc SAS. SailingLoc is an intermediary platform that enables registered individuals to enter into peer-to-peer rental contracts for sailboats and motorboats in France, Europe, and internationally. By accessing the platform, the user unreservedly accepts these Terms of Use.

2.title: Article 2 - Nature of the service
2.body: SailingLoc acts exclusively as a technical intermediary. Rentals are concluded solely between registered individuals. SailingLoc does not own the boats listed and is not a party to the rental contract, except for the matching, payment, and support services associated with the platform.

3.title: Article 3 - Access to the platform
3.body: Browsing the site is free. Registration is required to rent a boat, publish a listing, or enter into a rental contract. Access is reserved for adults. The Company reserves the right to suspend any user in the event of a breach of these Terms of Use.

4.title: Article 4 - Registration and user account
4.body: The user agrees to provide accurate and up-to-date information. Identity theft is prohibited. The user is solely responsible for the confidentiality of their credentials. Only registered and active accounts may enter into rental contracts via the platform.

5.title: Article 5 - User obligations
5.body: The user agrees to use the platform in accordance with applicable laws and to offer only peer-to-peer rentals between individuals. It is prohibited to circumvent SailingLoc's payment systems or to use the platform for a professional rental activity that is not declared as such.

6.title: Article 6 - Bookings and rental contracts
6.body: Any confirmed booking constitutes a rental contract between the renter and the owner, both of whom are registered individuals. SailingLoc acts as an intermediary. The owner has 24 hours to accept or decline a request. In the event of no response, the booking is automatically cancelled.

7.title: Article 7 - Payments and commissions
7.body: Payments are processed by Stripe. SailingLoc collects 10% of each confirmed transaction as platform service fees. The exact amount is displayed before the booking is confirmed. Refunds are subject to the owner's cancellation policy.

8.title: Article 8 - Insurance
8.body: Each owner agrees to hold valid navigation insurance covering rental to third parties. SailingLoc may collaborate with insurance partners; this does not relieve the owner of their obligations, nor the renter of the duty to verify coverage terms before departure.

9.title: Article 9 - Termination
9.body: The user may delete their account from their settings. Financial obligations arising before termination remain due.

10.title: Article 10 - Governing law
10.body: These Terms of Use are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, the competent courts of Marseille shall have jurisdiction.
